verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a transcription API service, and such a product could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only HTTP API endpoints, webhooks, Zapier/Google integrations, an OpenAPI spec and a ClawHub agent skill; none of these is an official command-line tool. The OpenAPI spec is a developer building block and the agent skill is an adjacent feature, so neither earns partial credit.
